speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Presence of immature cells with large, prominent nucleoli and pink, elongated, needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions.

speaker: Doctor
text: The peripheral blood smear reveals immature cells (blasts) containing pink, needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions, which are pathognomonic for Auer rods. This finding confirms acute myeloid leukemia, specifically the acute promyelocytic leukemia variant. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL)
